summary: Add MCP server interface for fixos diagnostics and cleanup

delivery.outcome: Provide a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server interface for fixos conforming to wellmanifest/mcp and wellmanifest/nl-dsl-llm, with read/mutate operation separation, URI catalog search, NL task planning, and replayable task receipts.
nonGoals: Do not add mandatory third-party runtime dependencies; support stdlib JSON-RPC stdio and optional FastMCP.

architecture.decision: Implement fixos/mcp_server.py with a deterministic wellmanifest/mcp operation catalog (fixos:// URIs), advisory task_plan, receipt-backed task_execute/task_status, and stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 server, exposed via fixos mcp CLI command.
interfaceChanges: fixos mcp CLI subcommand and MCP stdio server tools
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-105 commit via protected publication.
